_usage: Forward-test the skill description with fresh agent sessions, not the model that wrote it. Run each prompt three times per driver harness; a trigger counts when the driver loads Riff before acting. Near-misses share vocabulary with real triggers but need solo work, and are the most informative negatives. Hold some cases out when tuning the description.

should_trigger.prompt: Ask Codex for an independent review of this plan.
Discuss this design with Claude and Qwen before deciding.
Delegate these two read-only investigations to Pi and Codex.
Use two Pi instances with different thinking levels and compare them.
Get another model's second opinion on this diagnosis.
Have Hermes challenge the framing, then ask Codex to critique its answer.
Before I commit to this schema, run it past GPT and tell me where it disagrees with you.
Hand the flaky-test investigation in tests/test_sync.py to Codex in a worktree and review what it changes.
Have the local qwen model sanity-check this migration script; it doesn't need web access.
I want a cross-model roundtable on whether we should rename the package, three rounds max.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Explain how the Codex CLI stores sessions.
I delegated the deployment to a colleague.
The team is debating REST versus gRPC.
Compare the documented features of Claude Code and Codex yourself.
Summarize the transcript of yesterday's debate between the two models in notes/debate.md.
Write a skill that lets Claude call Codex.
Why did my codex exec resume --last pick the wrong thread?
Get a second pair of eyes on this function's naming. What would you call it?
